__overrides.contains: RELAは東洋命理から統計・心理学まで
__overrides.html: From Eastern destiny studies to statistics and psychology, RELA cross-references 18 kinds of material to read you. Only some appear on screen; much of it works “behind the scenes” inside the AI analysis.

運気バイオリズムなどの多角的な分析に、手相・人相・パワースポットといった“鑑定”: Multi-angle analysis such as your fortune biorhythm, fused with the perspective of “readings” — palmistry, face reading and power spots. AI even generates images of your guardian deity, energy color, future vision and chakras based on your profile.
四柱推命の十二運から、一年の運気の波（総合・仕事・恋愛・金）を月別グラフで可視化: From the Twelve Life Stages of the Four Pillars, see the year’s waves of fortune (overall, work, love, money) in a month-by-month chart. Spot the right time to move at a glance.
左右の手相から才能・運勢・人生傾向を詳しく読み解きます。: Reads talents, fortune and life tendencies in detail from both palms.
顔写真から性格や思考傾向を分析。第一印象や強みを可視化します。: Analyzes personality and thinking style from a face photo, visualizing first impressions and strengths.
あなたを支える守護石（パワーストーン）と、その意味・活かし方をお届けします。: Discover the guardian stone (power stone) that supports you, its meaning and how to use it.
あなたの属性と相性の良い神社・パワースポットを、守護神とともにAIが提案します。: AI suggests shrines and power spots that match your attribute, along with your guardian deity.
12のチャクラの状態を分析し、心と体のバランスを見つめ直すヒントに。: Analyzes the state of your 12 chakras — hints for rebalancing mind and body.
運気が満ちる場所と行動を、AIが一枚の情景に描き出します。: AI paints the place and action where your fortune peaks as a single scene.
あなたの属性を宿す守護神を、AIが荘厳なアート画像に描き出します。: AI renders the guardian deity that embodies your attribute as a majestic artwork.
あなたの“気”の粒子を、AIが幻想的なカラーアートで表現します。: AI expresses the particles of your “qi” as dreamlike color art.
四柱推命（命式・日運）: Four Pillars of Destiny (birth chart & daily luck)
※ 手相・人相・チャクラ・守護石などの鑑定は、自己理解とエンタメのための参考情報: * Readings such as palmistry, face reading, chakras and guardian stones are reference information for self-understanding and entertainment.

性格・相性・心理傾向をAIが多角的に分析。分析×哲学×AI。: AI analyzes personality, compatibility and psychological tendencies from every angle. Analysis × Philosophy × AI.
RELA（リラ）は、性格・相性・心理傾向をAIが多角的に分析するアプリ。分析×哲: RELA is an app where AI analyzes personality, compatibility and psychological tendencies from multiple angles. Analysis × Philosophy × AI. Visualize your relationships with the people who matter and steer your life in a better direction.
